title: How CDs Store an Album and a Game

scenes.text: What lets a 700 MB CD hold both music and video game data?
A single spiral track encodes data as tiny pits and lands.
scenes.label: PITS AND LANDS ENCODING

scenes.text: Error‑correction codes like CIRC recover missing bits, keeping music and game data intact.
scenes.label: CIRC ERROR CORRECTION

scenes.text: The Table of Contents at the disc’s start tells the player where each track or game file begins.
scenes.label: TABLE OF CONTENTS
